captions.detailed: A cylindrical home air purifier with a light gray body, featuring a flat-backed access door on one side and a prominent black control ring on the top. The rear access door is mounted on a vertical hinge, allowing it to swing open and reveal the interior. Inside, a cylindrical filter can slide out horizontally through the door opening. The black control ring on top is designed to rotate continuously around the central vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cylindrical home air purifier with a light gray main body and a dark gray/black top control ring. It should include a hinged rear access door that rotates open, an internal cylindrical filter that slides out prismatically, and a top control ring that rotates continuously around the vertical axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject representing the air purifier. It models the main body as a hollowed cylinder with a flat cutout on the rear for the door. A rectangular door panel is created with a vertical hinge offset to rotate via a revolute joint. The internal filter is modeled as a smaller cylinder that translates along a radial axis via a prismatic joint. The top control ring is constructed as a thin, dark torus/ring placed at the top of the body, rotating via a continuous joint.
